human.outcome.protocol.predeclared: TEST leaf module binds a two-condition claim, balanced trials, success thresholds, retention and authority before responses exist.
The current participant packet omits condition roles and expected decisions.
human.outcome.consent.bound: Completed sessions require voluntary opt-in and completion confirmation.
Withdrawal omits participant reference, observations and participant judgment.
human.outcome.observation.structured: Responses are decision, confidence, confusion, elapsed time, effect and burden only.
The module cannot authenticate that a declared LIVE response was entered by a human.
human.outcome.retention.minimal: Raw identity, free text, audio, video, screen recording and network transport are refused.
The module returns values in memory or stdout and performs no session writes.

human.outcome.evaluation.deterministic: Exact protocol and session ancestry deterministically derive bounded accuracy, unsupported-continuation, time, burden and participant-effect signals.
Numeric signals remain distinct from human judgment.
human.outcome.judgment.explicit: A final receipt requires an explicit claim-scoped declared human attestation.
Source authentication and the actual governance decision remain external; no real human judgment has been run.
human.outcome.synthetic.separated: Synthetic sessions and judgments remain unusable as live human evidence and cannot take live source labels.
human.outcome.digest.receipts: Protocol, session, evaluation and judgment receipts are SHA-256 bound and deterministically rebuildable.
This does not install, promote or update the current Grounded Growth outcome.
